title: docs(skills): objectstack-data teaches rollupSourceUnreadableReason beside security-rollup-source-unreadable
body:
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_ Fixes #34742 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：`objectstack-data` 技能的汇总可见性规则多教一条出路。权限集「该看汇总、不该看明细」时，保留该列可读，并在该集的字段条目上写 `rollupSourceUnreadableReason` 说明原因；评测集加一道对应的题。 - 为什么改：这个键已随平台落地，但技能只教「给子对象读权限」或「遮掉汇总列」两条路，AI 仍会用需求禁止的读授权去压警告，或把需求要给的汇总遮掉。 - 风险与回滚：只改技能文字、一道评测题和该文件的 token 上限行，不动产品代码。同文件删了 6 处重复付账，上限不升反降（4229 → 4221）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。 - 先看：`skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` 的「Never finish with …」一段及其示例（新教学，另把「先摘掉 View All / Modify All」改为只说 Modify All）；同文件被删的 6 处重复；`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 里 `relationships.md` 那一行及注释。 - 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`，预期末行以 `✓ check-skills-token-ratchet: 58 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings` 开头。 - 需要你做的：请审阅并批准。`check-governed-merges` 判为 Tier H（`skills/**`）；席位达档合同审 6964794395 判 `Security-touching: yes`（本 PR 讲授权限集字段遮罩与 Modify All 的覆盖关系），低风险 skills 通道不适用，需 os-zhuang 批准后由席位落地。合同审 PASS，L1 ACCEPT，无 must-fix / should-fix。 ## What changes **`skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`** (§ Roll-up Summaries, the "Never finish with `security-rollup-source-unreadable` standing" paragraph and its example). The paragraph named two ways out per permission set. It now names three, chosen from the request: - the set sees the children: grant the read (unchanged); - the set sees the total but not the children: keep the column readable and add `rollupSourceUnreadableReason` to the set's entry for it. The warning becomes a note quoting the reason. The reason is refused blank or beside `readable: false`; - neither: mask the summary on that set (unchanged, see the Modify All note below). It ends with the card's guard: never add the reason to silence a total the request withholds; mask it. The `client_viewer` example gains the acknowledged entry as a commented alternative to the mask line: `fields: { 'project.task_count': { readable: true, rollupSourceUnreadableReason: 'Clients see progress counts, not tasks' } }`. **The mask sentence names Modify All alone.** It said to remove "any View All / Modify All it holds on the parent (either overrides the mask)". That is no longer true for View All: under the ADR-0066 D2 ⑧ note of 2026-11-15 a set's own `readable: false` row binds beside that set's own View All, and only its Modify All unbinds it. The lint rule's own hint names Modify All only. The sentence I was extending would have kept teaching an unneeded removal, so it now reads "after removing any Modify All it holds on the parent (it overrides the mask)". The same parenthetical in the existing mask eval case (id 20) is brought in line; its assertions are untouched. **`skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json`**. The mask case (id 20) stays. One case is added after it (id 27): the request says clients should see how many tasks each project has but never read the tasks, so the answer keeps the column readable and acknowledges it with a reason. Ids 25 and 26 are left for the open PR #34964, which appends them at the end of the file; this case sits mid-file so the two do not touch the same lines. **`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`**: the `relationships.md` row follows the measurement down, 4229 to 4221, with the arithmetic in its comment. **`.changeset/34742-skills-rollup-source-unreadable-reason.md`**: `@objectstack/skills` patch. No version caveat is taught: `@objectstack/skills` is versioned and published with the other packages, so the text ships in the release that carries the key. ### How the file is paid for The row had zero headroom (16916 bytes, ceiling 4229 = ceil(16916 / 4)). The teaching adds 419 bytes. Six restatements are cut from the same file, 451 bytes, each with the text that still carries it: | Cut | Bytes | Still carried by | |:---|---:|:---| | The `'grid'` and `'form'` bullets under "Inline-edit form factor" | 236 | The code comments beside the three `inlineEdit` values ("editable line-item grid (fast bulk entry; thin children)", "read-only list; … opens the FULL form") and the smart-default sentence (rich or form-only fields, or more than ~8 editable fields, pick `form`) | | "Where `inlineEdit` is the write side, the related list … is the read side" lead-in | 67 | The heading "Detail-page related lists (the read-side mirror)" and the `relatedList: 'primary'` comment "read side: a body table" | | "part of the record's main content:" in the `'primary'` bullet | 37 | The same bullet: "a full-width table in the record's detail body" | | Comment "One assignment per (project, employee) pair." | 52 | The index line under it: `{ fields: ['project_id', 'employee_id'], unique: 'organization' }` | | Comment "Child: Contact (independent lifecycle) of an account" | 55 | The Relationship Types table (`lookup`: Independent) and the example's own `account_id` lookup | | Comments "On the PARENT object:" (roll-up block) and the second "On the CHILD object's FK field:" (related-list block) | 60 | "A parent `summary` field aggregates a child collection" directly above; the first "On the CHILD object's FK field:" comment in Inline Editing, and "The relationship flags" lead-in | Net: 16916 to 16884 bytes, ceil(16884 / 4) = 4221. No raise. ### Size readings (`skills/**`) | Reading | Before (`6d2db1d7ef`) | After (`df1e9b4764`) | |:---|---:|---:| | `rules/relationships.md`, lines | 414 | 409 | | `rules/relationships.md`, bytes / tokens | 16916 / 4229 | 16884 / 4221 | | All `SKILL.md` files, lines (none touched) | 4730 | 4730 | | All authored `.md` under `skills/` outside `evals/`, lines | 18036 | 18031 | | Eval file (unpriced), lines / bytes | 245 / 22460 | 255 / 23747 | ## Tests All on head `df1e9b4764`.
Premise, re-measured on origin/main 6d2db1d7ef - `relationships.md:228-234` named grant or mask only. - `git grep -n rollupSourceUnreadableReason -- skills` answered zero lines (control: the same word hits `packages/lint/src/validate-rollup-source-visibility.ts` and `packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts`).
Every taught clause, probed against the built lint rule and the spec schema One throwaway script (not committed) ran `validateRollupSourceVisibility` from the rebuilt `packages/lint/dist` over a `project` / `task` stack with a `client_viewer` set, and `FieldPermissionSchema.safeParse` from `@objectstack/spec/security`: ```text none [["warning","security-rollup-source-unreadable", …]] mask [] reason [["info","security-rollup-source-unreadable","… Acknowledged on the set: \"Clients see progress counts, not tasks\""]] parse reason+readable:true ok parse blank refused: rollupSourceUnreadableReason parse reason+readable:false refused: rollupSourceUnreadableReason mask + View All [] mask + Modify All ["warning"] ``` So: the reason drops the finding to `info` (the "note" the docs name) under the same id and quotes it; it is judged per set and per column entry (`acknowledgedReason` reads the set's own entry for that column only); a blank reason and a reason beside `readable: false` are refused at parse; the set's own mask binds beside its own View All and not beside its own Modify All.
Eval assertions, checked by script No gate reads eval assertions outside `ui/`, so a script checked the file: 25 cases, 25 distinct ids, every `must_contain` token is in its `expected_output`, no `must_not_contain` token is, 0 violations. The new case's tokens are layout-independent, because `packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/grade.ts` matches literal, case-sensitive substrings with no normalisation: `summary`, `project.task_count`, `rollupSourceUnreadableReason`. Two checks are left out on purpose, since neither can be spelled without depending on whitespace or quoting: that the entry is not `readable: false`, and that the set carries no `task` read grant. A wrong answer of either kind (mask, or grant the read) still fails the case, because it has no reason to carry `rollupSourceUnreadableReason`.
No ablation: the diff changes skill prose, an eval fixture and a ratchet row, and no tested behaviour. ## Acceptance notes - The card's proposed text is fitted to the skill's style and to the measured behaviour; the one departure from it is the Modify All correction above. - The existing mask case (id 20) keeps its layout-dependent tokens; only the new case follows the layout-independent rule. - The eval file is also edited by open PRs #35022 and #34964. `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` against `origin/main` 65ec3c50a3 and the open PR heads answered `VERDICT clean exit 0` (#35038, #35022 and #34964 each merge cleanly with this branch). ## Verification
Local gates: 64 derived, 62 run, 2 NOT MEASURED - `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@objectstack/lint...' build` under the verify lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0`. - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` then `--ran`: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 64 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 62 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (2 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3).` Every run family exited 0. - NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, reason: exit 3, prerequisite not met (needs a full build); `check:lean-entry-closure`, reason: the same. Both are left to CI. - `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: exit 0, `✓ check-skills-token-ratchet: 58 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings; 10 generator-owned file(s) and 30 eval fixture(s) measured, not ratcheted.` Its `--self-test`: exit 0. - `pnpm check:skill-links`: exit 0, `✓ check-skill-links: 256 relative link(s) in 72 published skill file(s) resolve; 130 fragment(s) name a real heading under GitHub's slug rule.` - `test:repo` and the repo-wide lint are CI's runs, not run locally.
